topic: How Light, Sound, and Heat Travel
key_concepts: Transparent materials let light completely pass through
Translucent materials let some light pass through
Sound is produced by vibration of particles
Sound travels through solids, liquids, and gases
Sound travels fastest in solids and slowest in gases
The speed of sound depends on the type of medium
Conduction transfers heat through direct contact, especially in metals
Convection transfers heat through the movement of warm and cold air or fluids
Radiation transfers heat without direct contact, such as sunlight or ultraviolet rays
